plain_english_revision: This amendment modifies the unemployment compensation eligibility requirement by adding a geographic exception to the mandatory job-search frequency rule. Specifically, it exempts individuals from the weekly search obligation if they live within 45 miles of a Career Center (state employment service office) or if they reside farther than 45 miles but can reach at least one prospective employer within that distance.
candidate_position_supported: reduces administrative burden on unemployed individuals in rural areas by relaxing job-search frequency requirements when access to Career Centers or employers is limited
evidence_quotes: if he or she resides within 45 miles of a Career Center, or at least one prospective employer if he or she resides 45 miles or more from a Career Center
